source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 336 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 336 was established by Ordinance No. 20732, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 12, 1990. Ordinance No. 20732 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 336 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of St. Rosalie Drive and Circlewood Drive. The size of PD 336 is approximately 0.6271 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform with the site plan and landscape plan (Exhibit 336A). (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the site plan and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.106. USES.

Use of the Property is limited to the uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District and a personal care home for the aging use. For the purposes of this article, a personal care home for the aging use means a facility which furnishes room, board, and one or more services of a personal care or protective nature. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Driving Of Private Vehicles Prohibited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.107. DRIVING OF PRIVATE VEHICLES PROHIBITED.

In order to insure that the parking provided for this use is adequate, a personal care home for the aging use must adhere to its program policy prohibiting residents from driving private vehicles to and from the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Residents
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.108. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF RESIDENTS.

A maximum of 19 persons may reside in the personal care home for the aging use, including a maximum of ten full-time residents, four respite or temporary residents, and five caregivers (including family members of caregivers). (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.109. SETBACKS.

Setbacks must be provided as shown on the development plan. If the Property is developed with uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District and the development plan is amended, setbacks must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.110. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage is 45 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.111. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height is 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

(a) Requirement. Four parking spaces must be provided for the personal care home for the aging use. If the Property is developed with uses permitted in an R-7.5(A) Single Family District, parking must be provided as required for those uses in the Dallas Development Code.

(b) Study. In order to determine the adequacy of the parking provided on the Property, a parking demand study must be submitted to the director of public works and transportation within 18 months after the issuance of a certificate of occupancy. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-336.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 336 is located on Zoning Map No. O-11. (Ord. Nos. 20732; 25850)
